name: com.refinery89.sharedcore.os_layer.cheat_screen.CheatScreenViewAndroidImplActivity
description: When the Refinery89 Monetize App SDK opens its built-in diagnostic screen, this Activity lists tools for checking app details, ad setup, saved preferences, and SDK logs. It also provides links to ad inspection and creative preview tools.
disableEffect: Refinery89's built-in diagnostic and ad-preview screens cannot be opened, while ordinary app screens remain available.
